author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the console launch trailer for Instant Sports 2, a sequel to the hit sports action game developed by Breakfirst Games. Players will compete in an array of different sports, including baseball, base jumping, mini-golf, and more. Create a customized character and get the win across vibrant themed zones alone or with up to four players. Instant Sports 2 is now available for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Instant Sports 2 - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch trailer for Teeto, a 3D platformer adventure where players guide a small, blue blob named Teeto and their energetic bunny companion, Nory, on a journey to save a world consumed by shadow creatures. As life fades and once vibrant places fall into decay, Teeto and Nory must uncover the source of the corruption and restore the world. Teeto is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Teeto - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: What if dinosaurs were still around – and wielded as weapons – during medieval times? That's the alternate-history question asked by Dinolords, and upcoming adventure/strategy/townbuilding game. Check out this new gameplay explainer trailer, and wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587620/Dinolords/
title: Dinolords: Official Gameplay Explainer Trailer
